arms.title: Plain invitation
arms.description: The existing event invitation lists only the date, location and workshop agenda in plain text without attendee reviews.

arms.title: Social proof invitation
arms.description: The new event invitation includes testimonials, positive quotes and recommendations from previous workshop attendees.

batches.text: The first email group saw enthusiastic quotes from people who attended last year.
The other email group only received the venue, schedule and date, without participant recommendations.
Later recipients read praise and recommendations written by past participants.
Later recipients got just a factual agenda, time and place with no reviews.
